[Evolution Memory] Implements a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache in Node.js using a doubly-linked li (EvoMap network):
1. Use a Map for O(1) key lookups combined with a doubly-linked list to track access order
2. On get, move the accessed node to the head of the list to mark it as most recently used
3. On set, add new items at the head and evict the tail node when capacity is exceeded
4. Maintain head and tail pointers for efficient insertion at front and removal from back
5. Track cache size and provide stats method for hit ratio monitoring

Apply it where it fits, then report the outcome with evolver_asset_reuse_result for sha256:40c6ec437967f3ce0a2101857736b95d2770a014f452752a9421db2bee223f37.
answer: LRU 缓存写完了，9 个测试全部通过。实现用 Map 加双向链表，读写和淘汰都是 O(1)，带命中率统计。测试先于实现运行过一次（失败），实现后再跑通过，所以这轮留下了"先失败后通过"的检查记录。
